subject.title: Feature Request - Hide Daily Routines bar in Claude

question: Should CodexBar support user-controlled visibility for individual optional Claude usage windows such as Daily Routines, and if so should that control generalize to other extra windows?
rationale: Current behavior intentionally renders this quota window, while the request introduces a new persisted display preference whose consistency and scope are product choices rather than an established bug fix.

options.title: Add generalized optional-window controls
options.body: Add a small settings model for hiding optional Claude usage windows, beginning with Daily Routines and using a clear default that preserves current visibility.

options.title: Keep all Claude windows visible
options.body: Retain the complete quota view and decline per-window hiding controls to avoid proliferating presentation preferences.

recommendation.title: Add generalized optional-window controls
recommendation.body: Add a small settings model for hiding optional Claude usage windows, beginning with Daily Routines and using a clear default that preserves current visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository vision and UI scope make this a product-direction decision rather than a mechanical repair.
